C0866.title: Company in Laishan, Yantai Hit by WannaCry Ransomware Attack
C0866.summary: In February 2026, a company's servers in Laishan, Yantai were infected with ransomware, locking its databases. Investigation revealed that attackers exploited a file upload vulnerability in the business system to implant a backdoor, which then deployed the WannaCry ransomware, encrypting a large number of files.

references.title: Company Files 'Poisoned and Encrypted': Laishan Cyber Police Investigate a Ransomware Attack Case
